Package app.swea2

package app.swea2

Inst-Pal — Personal Finance Tracker

This package contains all application classes for Inst-Pal, a JavaFX desktop application for personal finance management.

Architecture

The application follows a lightweight MVC pattern split across three source files:

  • Models.java — domain model classes (User, Transaction, Budget, Goal, Report, Notification, Category, BudgetAlert) plus the UserStore persistence layer.
  • Controllers.java — one controller per screen, each responsible for wiring events and orchestrating model updates.
  • View.java — one view class per screen that builds the JavaFX scene graph and exposes UI controls to its controller.

Persistence

User records are stored in users.json. Transactions are stored per-user in transactions_&lt;userId&gt;.json. All I/O is handled by UserStore.

Styling

The UI uses a dark navy theme defined in styles.css.
